claude.performance_metric: Nov 2016 spin-off of International Seaways (~$895.65m net assets distributed); $332.56m held-for-sale impairment on distributed group; continuing-ops revenue declined $462.42m (2016) to $366.16m (2018)
claude.rationale: The slice documents a corporate separation (spin-off of INSW) and declining revenues plus repeated vessel-specific impairments on the retained articulated tug-barge fleet ($97.78m, $6.62m, $5.88m), but these are asset-level DCF write-downs, not evidence of an acquired product failing to align with operating processes, so p4 cannot be affirmatively determined (uncertain). There is no documented friction between operations and people/management/culture — the record covers financial and vessel-impairment trajectory only — so p5 is coded 0 (not documented). No documented controlling-intent archetype incoherence (t1=0) or irreconcilable business-model incompatibility (t2=0) appears in the realized record.
